payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_session.py::test_a_witness_that_only_raises_under_an_edit_reads_raised_and_files_a_concern stayed green with the spec's wrong version '`_apply_criterion_probes` swaps in a literal `assert` pattern whenever any pattern is declared.' applied to saffron/cell/session.py as an edit. The claim was '`_apply_criterion_probes` takes a required keyword `assertion` and hands it to `witness_gate`. A pair whose witness raised under that pattern reads `raised`, never `killed`, for a criterion probe, a wrong version and a parent\'s version alike. Its summary is the gate\'s own. Its line is read as a survivor\'s is, and it files one `adequacy` concern through `review.raised_finding`, anchored as a survivor\'s finding is, with no probe. It gets no second ask, and it is never a blocker. `review.rebut_concerns` exempts a `HOST_FILED` concern from the anchor check, as `anchored_blockers` exempts a host-filed blocker, so an unanchored raise still reaches REBUT\'s concerns and `anchored_concerns`. An unanchored lens concern still does not. A line read that returns `None`, or text without the edit\'s `find`, reads `error` with the summary "the raised edit\'s line could not be read". A read that stops the cell reads `error` and asks the same pair again in a fresh cell. With no pattern the same raise reads `killed`, and under a pattern naming `KeyError` a `KeyError` reason reads `killed` and an `assert` reason reads `raised`. The witness drives `_run_apply_criterion_probes` over nine pairs in two cells, with eleven `tests` results: a criterion probe, a wrong version and a parent\'s version that raise, a wrong version killed by an assertion, a survivor, two raises whose read returns `None` and lacks the `find`, a raise whose read stops the first cell, and a raise whose line shares no token with the diff. It asserts every outcome and each raised summary. It asserts the five concerns\' claims, lens, line, anchor and probe, the last one unanchored. It asserts that only the survivor reaches `check_probe` and `anchored_blockers`, and six findings in all. Beside an unanchored lens concern, `rebut_concerns` returns the five and `anchored_concerns` counts five. It then drives one raise under no pattern, and two pairs under `^KeyError\\b`.', and only that witness ran under the edit.
